steps.content: (Scene change)

Late at Night
Office Break Room

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Good evening, Tracy... oh, wait, actually, good morning. If you're here to heat up food, you might want to try another floor. The microwave here is... well...
Tracy looks up from her convenience store meal box to find the microwave emitting a burnt, acrid stench. Inside, exploded eggshells and smears of yolk are still caked onto the walls.

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: Someone put a whole egg in the microwave?! I haven't eaten in eight hours, and this is what the universe gives me. A biohazard...

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Want me to call maintenance?
Evie approaches with concern, but Tracy doesn't seem to notice. She simply picks up her phone and starts taking selfies.

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: Phanuel... this is my day fifteen of overtime. No water break. No sleep. And the microwave exploded right before I came to heat up food... I'm so, so miserable. Could you maybe say something to me? Please please please...
Tracy admires her post a few times with satisfaction. Only after hitting send does she realize Evie has been standing beside her, watching the entire time.

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: Ah! Evie! Sorry, I totally zoned out. What did you say? If it's about the microwave, it's fine, I'll just go to another floor. Stairs. Cardio. Win-win, right?

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: You're... weirdly cheerful right now. Did something good happen at work...?

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: Good? At work? Nope. Same as always. Boss drops random tasks on me last-minute. I spend half my day begging for deadline extensions. And my coworkers? Masters at dodging responsibility.

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: Office life, my friend, is a survival game where the only rule is: you don't get to leave until you've suffered enough. Rated M for Mature. Very dark themes.
Evie slaps her hands over her ears.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: ...Too dark. Way too dark. I'm delicate. My heart is aching now. Thank you.

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: But! Lucky me, I've found the cheat code. Ta-da!
Tracy shows Evie her phone screen, which now proudly displays a badge: "Phanuel Fan Club Member Lv.1."

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Phanuel...? I want to hear everything! Right now!

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: Honestly? It's a pretty short story.
Tracy recounts how she fell down the rabbit hole after accidentally stumbling upon that strange video at Nelson's desk.

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: I know this sounds crazy, but Phanuel's smile... it was like an actual cure. One look, and my back stopped hurting. My legs stopped hurting. Suddenly I had the energy to do actual work! It's like magic!

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: So naturally, I paid real money for the limited wallpaper. Now she lives on my phone. Every time I check a work message, I get one second of eye contact with Phanuel first. It's my little ritual.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Oh my gosh, the fact that I haven't seen this on a fan photo account is a crime against me personally!

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: It's so cute! Right?!
Tracy presses her phone screen to her cheek and rubs it back and forth affectionately.

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: A few days ago, I didn't get the whole fan thing at all. But now... I used to just complain. About overtime, about the pressure, about everything. But look at Phanuel. Her schedule's way worse than mine. Everyone's watching her, all the time. She can't afford to mess up, not even once.

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: And she's still smiling, always full of energy. Even when she's exhausted, she still finds time to listen to her fans' little problems. If she can do all that... what excuse do I have?

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Oh, I totally get it! Before Mimi-meow, my life was just gray. Housing subsidies? Meal allowances? Afternoon snacks? Whatever—

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: Wait, you'd give those up?

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Of course not! But they're nothing compared to my personalized voice message from Mimi-meow. She even says my name in it. My actual name! I got it at a fan meeting, hehe.
Evie takes out her phone and taps the screen awake.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: I play it after a bad day, and suddenly I'm fine. Ready to crawl back to Otriana and be their best little workhorse again!

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: Hold on. Personalized? As in... just for you? Only you? Mimi-meow recorded a message for you specifically?!

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: Ugh. Underground idols really have the upper hand here. Zero barriers. Actual personal connection. I want Phanuel to blow up and headline stadiums, but... fame makes things so complicated, you know.

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: Good thing she's literally the most approachable superstar on the planet. No matter how packed her schedule gets, she still replies to fans in the comments. She's actually replied to me. Me!
Tracy navigates to Phanuel's post with practiced ease, scrolling through thousands of comments until she finds the one where Phanuel replied to her.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Wow, she actually replied... I didn't think a star that big would be so down-to-earth. Or maybe it's your energy, Tracy. Your love reached her. Like Mimi-meow and me. It's mutual love!

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: So, real talk. If I really go for it, could I break into the weekly voting leaderboard? Get one of those thirty-second one-on-one video calls with Phanuel?

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Wait, you guys have voting too? Okay, okay, I've got some tricks for you... Step one: you make a bunch of accounts! Step two: you log into all of them every day, just a little, to keep them active—

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: But wouldn't that split your votes? Instead of stacking them all on one account?

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: No, no, you're missing the big picture. One person running multiple accounts pumps up the active user numbers. Higher active users, higher popularity metrics for Phanuel. It's all about the data!

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Timing matters too. You have to optimize your engagement windows. Treat it like an ops project in your work. Maximize the data impact!

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: Whoa... Evie, that's next-level! More, please! Teach me more!

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Okay, okay, a few more secret techniques from my personal vault...
The two huddle closer, their excitement mounting as their voices climb unchecked. Just then, a notification from the official Phanuel app lights up Tracy's phone.

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Quick! Open it!

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: Y-yeah, on it...!
Tracy holds her breath. Her finger, trembling with anticipation, touches the notification like a pilgrim approaching a holy relic.
Congratulations! You've been handpicked by Miss Phanuel herself to become a special Cherub! Accept your invitation to [StarChat] for insider updates and exclusive member perks!
Silence hangs between them for a single, taut moment. Then, like two eggs in a microwave, pressure builds and builds until they burst.

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: AHHHHHHHHHH I'M A SPECIAL CHERUB!!!!

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: AHHHHHHH TRACY THAT'S AMAZING!!!!
A detonation of pure, joyful screaming rips across the whole floor. Almost immediately, they catch themselves, their hands clamped over mouths, bodies hunched low in a desperate attempt to disappear.
To their relief, not a single colleague turns to glare. They exhale with relief and share a quiet grin.

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: Am I dreaming? Evie, tell me I'm not dreaming. You saw that, right? You saw it?!

steps.speaker: Evie
steps.content: Yes, I saw it! This is mutual, Tracy! Your love literally manifested!!! Phanuel sees you! She sees everything you've done!!!
Ping, ping. Somehow, even the message alerts have taken on a musical quality.
Tracy knows exactly what's waiting in those messages: her boss's impulsive new directives, colleagues shifting blame, the crushing weight of her parents' expectations...
But somewhere in that flood, there has to be something that gives her hope. Something to hold onto.
What kind of special perks could be waiting? Without a second thought, Tracy installs every software package that comes with the bundle.
StarChat, leaderboards, a merch store... everything feels oddly familiar and inviting. Hadn't she seen something like this on Nelson's computer?
